title: IrisRcSchema
description: Runtime workspace and profile configuration for iris-sync

activeProfile.description: Key of the active profile within the profiles dictionary

profiles.description: Dictionary of named synchronization and compilation profiles

server.description: Target server key defined in .iris-sync/servers.json or intersystems.servers

compileFlags.description: Compilation flags passed to Atelier REST API (e.g. cuk, cukd)

sourceRoot.description: Local workspace root directory containing ObjectScript files

watchPatterns.description: Glob patterns for files monitored by the background watcher

conflictPolicy.description: Concurrency resolution behavior when the server version has diverged (HTTP 409)
